$comment: Source of truth for Keystone hooks. Manifests in hooks/*.json are generated from this file by scripts/build_adapters.py. Hook IDs are a public interface: renaming one is a MAJOR change (ADR-001).

shell.description: before the agent runs a shell command

edit.description: before the agent writes or edits a file

stop.description: when the agent is about to end its turn

session-start.description: when a session starts, resumes or is compacted

review_only_invariants.2: Discovery is a reading habit; no tool call reveals that a command was invented rather than found.
review_only_invariants.3: Runtime checks arrive with git.force-push and irreversible.command (WP1).
review_only_invariants.5: Runtime checks arrive with the bar.* and git.no-verify hooks (WP1).
review_only_invariants.7: Boundary rules are project-specific; mechanical checks arrive with the 1.4.0 traceability graph.
review_only_invariants.8: Runtime checks arrive with secret.staged and secret.write (WP1).
review_only_invariants.9: Whether a model decides in a production path is a property of the design, judged in review.
review_only_invariants.10: Runtime checks arrive with the session.* hooks (WP5).
